services.name: Waterproofing
services.title_tag: Waterproofing Cape Town | Roof, Balcony and Wall Repairs
services.meta_description: Waterproofing in Cape Town for roofs, parapets, balconies, box gutters and basements. We find where the water enters before we quote. Free site visit.

leader.cta_line: Most leaks are not in the middle of the roof. They are at a junction, a parapet or a balcony edge that was never detailed properly. We start there.

services.intro_heading: Where Cape Town roofs actually leak
services.intro_body:
Cape Town's rain arrives with a north-westerly front that pushes water sideways across roofs and up under tiles. That is why so many leaks here are nowhere near the middle of the roof. They are at the upstand where a flat roof meets a wall, in the box gutter that has silted up, behind the flashing around a chimney, or at the edge of a balcony where the membrane was laid over a dirty surface.

Waterproofing fails in two ways. The material itself reaches the end of its life, which is predictable. Or the detail was wrong from the start, which is not, and it is the far more common of the two. A membrane laid without a proper primer, a fall that runs back towards the wall, a tile roof re-flashed with sealant instead of lead. You can redo the surface every year and still have a leak, because the water never entered where the surface is.

So we work from the water's point of view. We get into the ceiling void, read moisture through the plaster, and where it is not obvious we run a hose test on the suspect area and watch what happens inside. Only then do we specify a system, because the right answer on a fibre-cement roof is not the right answer on a concrete slab, and neither is the right answer on a wall that has to stay breathable.
services.detail_intro: Every one of these is a different substrate and a different detail. We treat them as separate jobs rather than one product applied everywhere.

subitems.name: Roof waterproofing
subitems.desc: Torch-on membranes, liquid-applied systems and acrylic coatings, chosen for the roof type and the pitch.

subitems.name: Parapets and flashings
subitems.desc: Upstands rebuilt to height, flashings replaced in metal rather than sealant, and wall junctions opened and re-detailed.

subitems.name: Balconies and terraces
subitems.desc: Falls corrected to the outlet, upstands raised, and the edge detail that fails first rebuilt from scratch.

subitems.name: Box gutters and valleys
subitems.desc: Silt removed, outlets resized, and the lining replaced where standing water has already gone through it.

subitems.name: Basement and retaining walls
subitems.desc: Positive-side treatment where we can get to it, drainage where we cannot, and a realistic explanation of what each buys you.

subitems.name: Penetrations
subitems.desc: Skylights, vents, solar mounts, TV aerials and plumbing stacks. Small openings, disproportionate amount of the damage.

cost.heading: What changes the price of waterproofing
rows: Area and access
A roof you can walk on is cheaper than one that needs scaffolding, a boom or a rope access team.
Substrate and condition
Sound concrete takes a coating. A crumbled screed, a rotten timber deck or a failed old membrane has to come off first.
Number of details
Ten penetrations and four upstands cost more in labour than 40 square metres of open field, even though the field is bigger.
System specified
A torch-on membrane, a liquid system and a cementitious coating sit at different price points and suit different roofs.
What is underneath
If water has reached the ceiling, the plaster and insulation may need replacing as well. We price that separately and only if it is needed.
cost.note: We quote after a site visit and a moisture check. We do not price waterproofing per square metre over the phone, because the details decide the job.

steps.detail: Roof surface, parapets, flashings, gutters and the inside of the ceiling void if we can reach it.
Moisture readings and a controlled hose test on the suspect area, so we know the entry point rather than the exit point.
A written system and prep method matched to the substrate, the pitch and the exposure.
Failed material stripped, surface primed, every junction detailed before the field is covered.
A final water test, plus photographs of each layer before it was covered, so you know what is under there.

whyus.detail: A hose test and a moisture meter cost us an hour and save you a second roof.
Upstands, flashings and outlets get rebuilt before any membrane is laid.
You get pictures of the prep and the membrane, because once it is covered you cannot check it.

whyus.point: Honest about what a coating can do
whyus.detail: If the substrate has failed, a coating is money spent twice. We will tell you that before you spend it.

services.cta_subtext: Book a free site visit and we will trace the leak before quoting the repair.

services.name: Damp Proofing
services.title_tag: Damp Proofing Cape Town | Rising Damp and Wall Repair
services.meta_description: Damp proofing in Cape Town. Rising damp, penetrating damp and condensation diagnosed properly, then treated at the source. Free written estimate.

leader.cta_line: Rising damp, penetrating damp and condensation look similar on a wall and need completely different repairs. Getting the diagnosis right is most of the job.

services.intro_heading: Three kinds of damp, three different repairs
services.intro_body:
Damp is a symptom, not a diagnosis. The same bubbling paint and tide mark at skirting height can come from groundwater rising through a failed damp course, from rain entering a wall from outside, or from warm air condensing on a cold internal surface. Treat the wrong one and the damp returns within a season, which is why so many owners end up repainting the same wall every year.

Rising damp is groundwater moving up through the brickwork because the original damp proof course has failed, been bridged by a later concrete path or patio, or was never there. It stops at roughly a metre and leaves a horizontal tide mark. Penetrating damp comes in from outside: a cracked render, a failed window seal, a leaking gutter soaking the wall head, or a plinth that sits below the external ground level. Condensation is different again, and common in Cape Town's older houses where windows have been sealed and heating added without any ventilation.

We identify which one you have before quoting. That means moisture readings at different heights, a look at the external ground level and drainage, and a check on how the room is ventilated and heated.
services.detail_intro: Each of these needs its own method. A chemical injection will not fix a leaking gutter, and a coat of sealant will not fix rising damp.

subitems.name: Rising damp
subitems.desc: Damp course injection, plus removal of the plaster that has absorbed salts, replaced with a salt-resistant render.

subitems.name: Penetrating damp
subitems.desc: Found on the outside and repaired there: render, sealant, flashings, sills and the ground level against the wall.

subitems.name: Condensation and mould
subitems.desc: Ventilation, extraction and surface treatment. Mould is a symptom of moist air, not of a leaking wall.

subitems.name: Bridged damp course
subitems.desc: Paths, patios and paving laid above the damp course, cut back and detailed so the wall can dry.

subitems.name: Salt-damaged plaster
subitems.desc: Contaminated plaster removed to a sound base and replaced with a render that tolerates salt.

subitems.name: Plinth and foundation level
subitems.desc: The base of the wall where ground water sits against the structure, including the plinth detail many older Cape homes rely on.

cost.heading: What changes the price of damp repair
rows: Which damp it is
A condensation problem needs ventilation. Rising damp needs a damp course and new plaster. The costs are not comparable.
Length of affected wall
Injection and replastering are priced by the metre of wall treated, inside and out.
Access to the base
Paving, patios and planted beds against the wall have to be opened or cut back to treat it properly.
Internal finish
If the plaster has to come off, the skirting, paint and sometimes the floor finish come with it.
Whether the outside is the cause
Fixing the external detail is often the cheaper half and the only one that lasts.
cost.note: We diagnose first and quote the repair that matches the cause. If a cheaper repair will genuinely hold, we will price that instead.

steps.detail: Moisture readings at several heights and positions to establish the pattern.
Ground levels, drainage, render condition, sills, gutters and any later addition bridging the damp course.
Which damp it is, what is causing it and what the repair involves, before any work is priced.
Injection, external repair, drainage or ventilation, depending on what the diagnosis says.
Salt-resistant render where needed, and a return visit to confirm the wall is drying.

whyus.detail: We will not sell you an injection for a problem caused by a leaking gutter.
Most damp repairs fail because only the inside was treated. We price both sides.
Contaminated plaster comes off and goes back with a render that tolerates salt, not standard skim.
A drying wall tells you whether the repair worked. We come back and read it.

services.cta_subtext: Get a damp diagnosis and a written estimate. No injection quoted before the cause is known.

services.name: Painting
services.title_tag: Painting Contractors Cape Town | Interior and Exterior
services.meta_description: Painting contractors in Cape Town for interiors, exteriors, roofs and kitchen cabinets. Proper surface preparation before a coat goes on. Free estimate.

leader.eyebrow: Painting and surface preparation, Cape Town
leader.cta_line: Paint is the last five percent of a painting job. The other ninety-five is preparation, and it is where most repaints fail.

services.intro_heading: Why repaints fail in one season
services.intro_body:
A coat of paint over a damp wall will blister. Paint over chalky, powdery plaster will peel in sheets. Paint over a crack that is still moving will crack again, in the same line, within months. None of these are paint problems. They are preparation problems, and Cape Town's coastal air and winter rain find every one of them.

We prepare before we paint. That means washing and degreasing, scraping back anything loose, cutting out cracks and filling them with something that can move, sealing bare plaster with the right primer, and only then applying a system matched to the surface. On exterior work it also means waiting for the wall to be dry, which in winter can mean rescheduling a day rather than painting wet masonry and hoping.

We also do the work that sits between painting and building: repairing blown plaster, replacing rotten window beads, re-puttying glass, sealing joints that have opened, and coating roofs that are sound but have lost their protection.
services.detail_intro: The surface decides the system. Enamel on a wall that needs a breathable coating is a mistake that shows up in the first wet winter.

subitems.name: Interior walls and ceilings
subitems.desc: Crack repair, skimming where needed, primer and two coats, with sheeting and daily clean-up.

subitems.name: Exterior walls
subitems.desc: Crack cutting, plaster repair, fungicidal wash and a coating chosen for the exposure.

subitems.name: Roof coating
subitems.desc: Cleaning, priming and a reflective or protective coating where the roof is sound but unprotected.

subitems.name: Kitchen cabinets
subitems.desc: Doors and frames removed, degreased, sanded, primed and sprayed or brushed, then rehung.

subitems.name: Doors, windows and trim
subitems.desc: Sanding back, filling, priming and enamel, including the bottom edge that weathers first.

subitems.name: Damp-affected walls
subitems.desc: Only after the source is fixed. Painting a damp wall is a delay, not a repair.

cost.heading: What changes the price of a repaint
rows: Preparation required
A sound wall takes two coats. A wall with blown plaster, cracks and old enamel takes days before the first coat.
Surface area and height
Double-volume rooms, stairwells and exteriors above one storey need access equipment and more time.
Coating system
A standard acrylic, a breathable mineral paint and a roof membrane are three different products at three price points.
Number of colours
Feature walls, ceilings in a different colour and trim all add cutting-in time.
What is being moved
Furniture, blinds, air conditioners and light fittings all have to come down or be protected.
cost.note: We price painting per room or per elevation after seeing the surface, not per square metre on a phone call.

steps.detail: Sound, chalky, damp or previously coated with something that will not accept new paint.
Wash, scrape, cut out cracks, repair plaster, sand, and mask everything that is staying.
The right primer for bare plaster, masonry, timber or a glossy existing coat.
Two coats in the specified system, with the finish checked in daylight rather than under a work light.
We walk the job with you, mark anything that needs attention and fix it before we pack up.

whyus.detail: We would rather spend an extra day prepping than come back next winter to fix peeling paint.
Blown plaster, rotten beads and open joints are fixed, not filled and hidden.
Exterior work is scheduled around dry walls, not around the calendar.
Furniture covered, floors protected, and a clean room at the end of each day.

services.cta_subtext: Get a written painting estimate that separates preparation from paint.

services.name: Kitchen Renovations
services.title_tag: Kitchen Renovations Cape Town | Design, Cabinets and Tiling
services.meta_description: Kitchen renovations in Cape Town. Layout, plumbing, electrical, cabinetry, stone and tiling handled by one team. Free written estimate after a site visit.

leader.cta_line: A kitchen is a plumbing job, an electrical job and a carpentry job in the same room. The order they happen in decides how it turns out.

services.intro_heading: The sequence matters more than the finish
services.intro_body:
Most kitchen renovations that go wrong were not let down by the cabinets. They were let down by the order of work. A new layout decided after the plumbing was moved. A stone top templated before the cabinets were level. An extractor chosen before anyone checked where the duct could go. Tiling started before the electrical second fix, so the sockets ended up in the wrong place.

We plan the sequence before demolition. That means agreeing the layout and the appliance list, marking the services, confirming what can move and what should stay, and writing all of it down. Only then do we strip the room.

We work with your design if you have one, and we will tell you honestly when a layout will cost more than it is worth because of where the waste pipe or the distribution board sits. If you do not have a design, we will plan a practical layout with you: working triangle, landing space beside the oven and fridge, and enough counter where you actually prepare food.
services.detail_intro: We take the room from strip-out to the last bead of silicone, including the trades that usually hold up the schedule.

subitems.name: Layout and planning
subitems.desc: Working triangle, appliance sizes and service positions agreed before anything is removed.

subitems.name: Plumbing and electrical
subitems.desc: Water, waste, sockets, lighting and the extractor duct, first-fixed and signed off before closing up.

subitems.name: Cabinetry
subitems.desc: Supply and fit, or fitting your supplied units, with the carcasses levelled and fixed to the wall properly.

subitems.name: Worktops
subitems.desc: Stone or engineered tops templated after the units are in and level, with cut-outs for sink and hob.

subitems.name: Tiling and splashbacks
subitems.desc: Floor and wall tiling with the falls and the grout lines planned, not fitted around the cabinets afterwards.

subitems.name: Finishing
subitems.desc: Silicone, trims, plinths, appliance installation and the snag list walked with you.

cost.heading: Indicative kitchen renovation ranges in Cape Town
rows: Refresh: new doors, worktop and splashback, same layout
Lower end of the market
Full renovation: new cabinetry, worktop, tiling and appliances, services largely in place
Middle of the market
Layout change: walls moved, plumbing and electrical relocated, new window or opening
Upper end of the market
cost.note: These are market ranges published by Cape Town kitchen contractors in 2026, not a quote from us. We give you a fixed written price for your actual room after a site visit, and it separates the essential work from the optional.

steps.detail: Room measured, appliances chosen, layout and services agreed, scope written.
Old units and finishes removed, floor and walls exposed, dust contained and a temporary kitchen set up.
Plumbing, electrical and extraction roughed in and checked before anything is closed up.
Cabinets levelled and fixed, stone templated and fitted, tiling, second fix and appliances.
We walk the room with you and work through the list before the final payment stage.

whyus.point: One team for the whole room
whyus.detail: Plumbing, electrical, carpentry and tiling sequenced by the same person, not three subcontractors blaming each other.
We test the water and the circuits while the walls are still open.

whyus.point: A usable kitchen during the work
whyus.detail: We plan a temporary setup so the family is not eating out for the whole job.
If moving the sink costs triple what it gains, we will say so before you decide.

services.cta_subtext: Book a free site visit and get a written kitchen estimate with the sequence included.
